purpose: Explicit mapping from a project page to the register records it lists. Each record is listed by its own identifier and is never combined with another. The exporter reads every listed record from its primary file, checks the identifier, name and stated basis, and refuses to export a page with several same-name records unless they are all listed here.

bases.name_exact: the record's name equals the project name
bases.name_similar: similar name only, no identifier link
bases.register_link: a register's own link joins the two records (checked against the REPD link table)
bases.neso_project_number: the NESO project number is the same (the suffix is the stage)
bases.unverified: relation not established by any identifier
